metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji lower in December 2020 than December 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good for NDSI calculation with SWIR and Green bands) - Date: December 2019 (2019-12-01 to 2019-12-31) vs December 2020 (2020-12-01 to 2020-12-31) - Location: Mount Fuji (approximately 35.36°N, 138.73°E) - NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) for snow detection 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud masking is essential for accurate NDSI measurements - Use Sentinel-2 QA60 band to mask clouds/cirrus - Filter for low cloud probability 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Check collection sizes for both years - Check pixel counts after cloud masking - Calculate mean NDSI for both periods - Compare: if 2020 < 2019, then A (Yes); otherwise B (No) - If NDSI values are invalid (>1 or <-1) or None, output C3 - If no valid pixels remain, output C2 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Mount Fuji location const mountFuji = ee.Geometry.Point([138.73, 35.36]); const roi = mountFuji.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer // Define time periods const dec2019Start = '2019-12-01'; const dec2019End = '2019-12-31'; const dec2020Start = '2020-12-01'; const dec2020End = '2020-12-31'; // Function to mask clouds using QA60 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; return image.updateMask(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0))); } // Function to calculate NDSI function addNDSI(image) { const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI'); return image.addBands(ndsi); } // Load Sentinel-2 for December 2019 const s2_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(dec2019Start, dec2019End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDSI); const size2019 = s2_2019.size().getInfo(); console.log('December 2019 Images: ' + size2019); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log('No images for December 2019.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Load Sentinel-2 for December 2020 const s2_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(dec2020Start, dec2020End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDSI); const size2020 = s2_2020.size().getInfo(); console.log('December 2020 Images: ' + size2020); if (size2020 === 0) { console.log('No images for December 2020.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate median composite for each period const comp2019 = s2_2019.median(); const comp2020 = s2_2020.median(); // Check pixel counts const pixelCount2019 = comp2019.select('NDSI').reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9} ).getInfo().NDSI; const pixelCount2020 = comp2020.select('NDSI').reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9} ).getInfo().NDSI; console.log('Valid pixels 2019: ' + pixelCount2019 + ', 2020: ' + pixelCount2020); if (pixelCount2019 === 0 || pixelCount2020 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean NDSI for both periods const ndsi2019 = comp2019.select('NDSI').reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9} ).getInfo().NDSI; const ndsi2020 = comp2020.select('NDSI').reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9} ).getInfo().NDSI; console.log('Mean NDSI Dec 2019: ' + (ndsi2019 !== null ? ndsi2019.toFixed(4) : 'null')); console.log('Mean NDSI Dec 2020: ' + (ndsi2020 !== null ? ndsi2020.toFixed(4) : 'null')); // Validate results if (ndsi2019 === null || ndsi2020 === null || isNaN(ndsi2019) || isNaN(ndsi2020)) { console.log('Calculation resulted in invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (ndsi2019 < -1 || ndsi2019 > 1 || ndsi2020 < -1 || ndsi2020 > 1) { console.log('NDSI values outside valid range [-1, 1].'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: Was 2020 lower than 2019? if (ndsi2020 < ndsi2019) { console.log('Yes, NDSI 2020 (' + ndsi2020.toFixed(4) + ') < NDSI 2019 (' + ndsi2019.toFixed(4) + ')'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No, NDSI 2020 (' + ndsi2020.toFixed(4) + ') >= NDSI 2019 (' + ndsi2019.toFixed(4) + ')'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
